new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&s&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&(p.kind==='PLAY_MANA'&&p.specialBtn)){clearInterval(t);r('Mana: '+p.messageText+' | '+p.specialBtn+' | '+(p.specialTargets||[]).length)}},200);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r("Timeout Prompt")},60000)})

new Promise(r=>{let n=0;let auto=null;const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&p.kind==='SELECT'&&p.mode==='priority'&&s&&s.stack.length===0&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&s.players.find(x=>x.me).battlefield.some(c=>c.name==='Guardian of Vitu-Ghazi')){clearInterval(t);r('fertig nach '+n+' Klicks, nextStop='+p.nextStop)}if(p&&p.kind==='PLAY_MANA'&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id){if((p.specialTargets||[]).length){const id=p.specialTargets.find(x=>document.querySelector('[data-obj="'+x+'"]'));const el=id&&document.querySelector('[data-obj="'+id+'"]');if(el){n++;el.click()}}else if(auto!==p.id){auto=p.id;const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=prompt-bar] button')].find(x=>/Länder automatisch/i.test(x.textContent||''));if(b)b.click();else g.autoPay()}}},600);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r('Timeout Einberufen nach '+n)},60000)})

new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&p.kind==='SELECT'&&p.mode==='priority'&&s&&s.step==='POSTCOMBAT_MAIN'){clearInterval(t);g.action('PASS_PRIORITY_UNTIL_MY_NEXT_TURN');r('Main 2 nextStop='+p.nextStop+' -> F9')}},150);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r('Timeout Main 2')},60000)})

new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const s=g.state;if(s&&((()=>{const me=s.players.find(x=>x.me);return me&&me.skips&&me.skips.length&&!me.active})())){clearInterval(t);r('skips='+s.players.find(x=>x.me).skips)}},150);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r("Timeout Zustand")},60000)})
